public.text: SGI is introduced in Phase 3, after foundational components are implemented in Phase 2. Semantic governance must begin before schemas, terminology, profiles, and data are implemented.
public.suggestedRevision: Establish minimum SGI in Phase 1 and Phase 2, including ownership, approval, versioning, publication, and change control. Develop advanced cross-asset capabilities progressively in Phase 3.
